text:
alex chen: Quick async check — Packaging/pricing change (RFC-421) is merged to staging but we need final signoffs on metering, billing mapping, and contract gating before we open the canary. Planning target: next Tue 08:00 PT for canary. Who's owning the remaining items?

maria gonzalez: I own the metering adapter work. PR #3486 is open, waiting on schema confirmation from billing. The adapter now writes meter_event.v2. Canary-safe? not yet — needs a migration run. Link: https://git/repo/pull/3486 :eyes:

jonathan park: Billing integration is almost there. Ratecard mapper has a small delta for reserved_capacity plans (price_id rename). I can ship a non-breaking mapper if we run a small backfill script. I suggest a 30m deploy window and disable auto-upgrade for existing ratecards. PR #3492.

alex chen: @maria and @jonathan — can you confirm timeline for the migration + backfill? If both are green we will gate by contract flag (Sophie) and do a canary with 5% traffic.

maria gonzalez: Migration schedule: I can run migration in staging today and prod migration in the canary window. Estimated 12min lock on metering DB (online migration). Backfill for historical aggregation is async and safe. I will add a migration script to the PR.

jonathan park: Backfill script estimated 45 minutes for the 90-day window; it runs off a batch job so not blocking deploy. The small live mapper change is < 10s of CPU per request; no perf regression expected. I can freeze ratecard auto-updates during canary.

sophie lee: Contract constraints: legal confirmed there is a customer notification requirement for pricing changes if we change billed units for Plus/Enterprise tiers. We can avoid notification only if the change is backward-compatible and gated by a feature flag for opted-in customers. Recommend we: 1) gate by flag 2) enable for internal/test tenants 3) trigger notifications for external tenants if we toggle on globally.

alex chen: Ok — decision path: (a) run metering migration + add migration job in PR (maria), (b) ship mapper with ratecard freeze + backfill (jonathan), (c) deploy behind contract feature flag and do canary at 5% (sophie).

alex chen: Quick checklist for rollout (adding here for visibility):
```
- [ ] metering migration script added to PR #3486 (maria)
- [ ] run migration in staging, smoke metering (alex/maria)
- [ ] mapper PR #3492 merged + ratecard freeze (jonathan)
- [ ] backfill job scheduled post-canary (jonathan)
- [ ] contract feature flag created + notification flow tested (sophie)
- [ ] canary 5% for 24h, monitor cost/latency/ingestion (eng-observability)
```

billing-bot: metering pipeline test job completed: all tests passed (duration 1m23s). Logs: https://ci/logs/12345 :white_check_mark:

maria gonzalez: I pushed a small schema diff to the PR, added the migration. ETA to ready-for-merge: today EOD PT.

jonathan park: I'll coordinate a 30m slot on Tue 08:00 PT for canary deploy. I'll also open a post-deploy runbook for the backfill job.

sophie lee: I'll create the contract_flag and a brief email template for customers who need notification. Should have that by EOD.

alex chen: Great — thanks all. If anything blocks, ping here and we'll escalate. Planning to mark this ready for canary tomorrow AM if all items ticked. :thumbsup:
